remarks:
Welcome to this two-story home that captures timeless appeal with its classic architectural lines 
Once inside, you'll be impressed by numerous upgrades, as well as the enhancing some original elements. First floor contains open living, dining area as well as an eat-in kitchen and additional flex space.  The second floor houses 3 bedrooms and a full bath.  The layout offers both functionality and comfort, ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Spend your free time relaxing on your covered front porch. This home provides easy access to grocery stores and major retailers. This is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy a blend of comfort, convenience, and community living. Don't miss the opportunity to call this HOME today!
